one_sentence_story: A traceable source artifact crosses a single luminous custody line, is conditioned by a transparent Context Capsule, resolves into a torus family with a cusp hexagonal fibre, and ends as an explicitly labelled S6 paper claim beside its receipt and world trace.

beats.title: Source is the start
beats.action: Reveal one amber source sheet on a dark hexagonal plinth; show only the legible labels SOURCE and S6 PAPER CLAIM.
beats.causal_move: The source artifact becomes the origin of the thread.
beats.camera: Locked 16:9 wide shot; source anchor at x=-5.4, y=-0.15, z=0.
beats.visual: Warm amber key light from below; all background network nodes remain dim and static.

beats.title: Evidence travels
beats.action: Draw one continuous cubic Bezier stream from the source sheet toward center; animate three small trace particles along the same path, shifting from amber to ice blue after the midpoint.
beats.causal_move: The source is converted into a visible evidence trace without adding a second storyline.
beats.camera: Keep the locked wide shot; the path is the only moving object besides its particles.
beats.visual: Two parallel strokes, one 7 px core and one 2 px halo; particle spacing is deterministic at 0.0, 0.55, and 1.10 seconds.

beats.title: Context is bounded
beats.action: A transparent glass capsule grows around the midpoint of the stream; the path remains visible through it and a clean label reads CONTEXT CAPSULE.
beats.causal_move: The same trace is given a bounded context container.
beats.camera: No cut; capsule centered at x=0.0, y=0.15, z=0 with a 1.7 by 2.5 unit footprint.
beats.visual: Cyan edge strokes at 35 percent opacity, one soft internal reflection, no dashboard panels or pseudo-text.

beats.title: Structure resolves
beats.action: The capsule contracts into a torus family: two nested torus rings remain on the stream axis while a small hexagonal fibre pinches at the cusp between them.
beats.causal_move: Bounded context is represented as the proposed geometric structure.
beats.camera: Use a 12 degree yaw and 8 degree pitch only during the morph, then settle back to the original angle.
beats.visual: Outer torus in ice blue, inner torus in pale cyan, cusp hexagonal fibre in white; all geometry has fixed stroke and no random motion.

beats.title: Claim closes with a receipt
beats.action: Extend the same stream to a white receipt sheet on the right plinth; reveal two large readable labels, CLAIM and WORLD TRACE, then place a small closed hexagon seal beside the line endpoint.
beats.causal_move: The geometric proposal is closed as a paper claim with a traceable receipt, not as consensus fact.
beats.camera: Final wide composition: source x=-5.4, capsule/torus x=0.0, receipt x=5.2; hold for 1.0 second.
beats.visual: Receipt is cool white with blue edge light; the words PAPER CLAIM remain visible until fade-out.

caption_script: A source artifact enters the frame.
Its evidence trace stays continuous as it crosses the scene.
A transparent Context Capsule bounds the context around that trace.
The capsule resolves into a torus family and a cusp hexagonal fibre.
The S6 result is presented as a paper claim with a receipt and world trace, not as consensus fact.

manim_plan.canvas: 16:9, 1672x941 reference composition; render at 1920x1080 while preserving the same normalized anchors.
primitives: Polygon for each six-sided basalt plinth
RoundedRectangle for source and receipt sheets
CubicBezier for the single evidence stream
RegularPolygon(n=6) plus a short line segment for the cusp hexagonal fibre
Rectangle with stroke opacity 0.35 for the Context Capsule
animation_order: Create evidence_stream and MoveAlongPath three trace particles
Create context_capsule around the existing stream
Transform context_capsule outline into torus_family while preserving the stream endpoint
Create receipt_world_trace and Write only the five approved labels
Hold final frame for 1.0 second, then FadeOut background network only
manim_plan.timing: Five beats use 1.6 seconds each; use smooth linear path progress for trace particles and there is no random seed or noise source.
manim_plan.text_policy: Render only SOURCE, S6 PAPER CLAIM, CONTEXT CAPSULE, CLAIM, and WORLD TRACE; never render pseudo-paragraphs.
